description: Urban Development Authority -  Declart Part of Township Development Area in Concurrence with Bingiriya Export Processing Zone.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property-related matters, specifically the declaration of specific land areas as an Urban Development Area under the Urban Development Authority Law. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, Grama Niladari divisions, and geographic specifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land development projects and land use planning.
